## Digital-home purpose
This website is not only an online CV or recruiter landing page. It is a connected space for multiple audiences:
- Employers and collaborators: professional experience, skills, CV, and project evidence.
- Developers: technical projects, implementation notes, and engineering archive.
- Students and educators: teaching, mentoring, learning hubs, and project guidance.
- General visitors: personal journey, interests, and the broader body of work.

## Professional focus
- Full-stack web application development with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, REST APIs, and authentication.
- Healthcare and education software workflows.
- Practical AI API integration in application features.
- Computer science teaching, student mentoring, and technical project guidance.

- VisionSpeak (in progress) — offline Windows object-detection exhibition prototype using Python, OpenCV and YOLO, with on-screen labels and English voice output. It is an exhibition prototype, not a finished product.

## Interpretation guidance
- Distinguish team projects from individually owned work; project pages state the documented role where known.
- Do not infer clinical validation, production readiness, or ownership of every component from a project description.
- Technologies are project-specific and do not imply equal proficiency across the entire listed toolset.
- The portfolio intentionally does not publish academic grades or CGPA.
